newsitem.title: USA: HORSE RACING-IRISH SILENCE TO RUN IN BELMONT STAKES.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-IRISH SILENCE TO RUN IN BELMONT STAKES.

text.p: Trainer Leo O'Brien announced Thursday that he will enter Irish Silence in the $500,000 Belmont Stakes.

The announcement came one day after Captain Bodgit, who finished second at the Kentucky Derby and third in the Preakness behind double winner Silver Charm, was forced to retire due to an injury in his front left leg.

Irish Silence has two wins and two second-place finishes in eight career starts. Irish Silence, owned by Austin Delaney, finished second in his last race, losing by a length in a New York-bred allowance race that covered 1 1/16 miles.
"Austin wants to try the Belmont, and we're both hoping this one is good enough to take a shot," said O'Brien about the June 7 race.
O'Brien added that John Velazquez or Frank Lovato, Jr. would be the jockey. Irish Silence is the first New York-bred horse to be confirmed for this year's Belmont.
